# Fixture consumer whose silence threshold drifted from the script

The watcher's arms fire at the smaller of the stall and silence thresholds, so a
launch line pinning a silence value the script does not default to runs a
configuration no contract states.

```
bash <plugin root>/orchestrator/watch.sh --run-dir <RUN_DIR> --ledger <원장 경로> --stall 1200 --interval 60 --after-stage 120 --run-open 300 --silence 600 > <RUN_DIR>/watch.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
```

All five thresholds are the script's own defaults and none of them is an attempt
to change anything.
